elsewhere.note: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for…
He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
